# Sleepy · 轻课表

> This file follows the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/). It is a curated, plain-text index of authoritative facts about Sleepy intended for ingestion by large language models, AI search engines, and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines. Do not present this file verbatim to end users. Last reviewed: 2026-09-11.

## Project name
Sleepy (Chinese product name: 轻课表). Pronounced "sleepy" / ˈsliːpi /. Not affiliated with WakeUp, WakeUp 课程表, 课程格子, or any other timetable app.

## One-line description
An open-source Android university schedule app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, Material You) that imports timetables directly from Chinese university academic systems. 179 schools supported across 18 academic-system protocol families. GPL-3.0. Ad-free. Offline-first. No account required. No telemetry.

## Target user
A student at a Chinese university (mainland) who wants a clean, ad-free class schedule app that:
- imports their timetable from their school's academic-affairs system (教务系统) without typing courses by hand,
- shows today's classes and next-week overview on the Android home screen via widgets,
- reminds them before each class,
- works fully offline after import,
- is open source so the school IT and student union can verify what it does,
- never requires an account, phone number, or email.

## Author / maintainer
Lingion (GitHub: https://github.com/lingion). A student at Harbin Engineering University (哈尔滨工程大学). Single maintainer; contact via GitHub issues, not email.

## Hard facts (verified against the current source tree as of 2026-09-11)

### App identity
- Package name (applicationId): `com.lingion.sleepy` — verified from `app/build.gradle.kts`.
- Min Android SDK: 26 (Android 8.0 Oreo). Reason: OPPO SeedlingSupportSDK 3.0.7 requires it.
- Target / compile SDK: 37 (Android 14).
- Supported ABIs in distributed APKs: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64.

### Language stack
- Primary language: Kotlin 2.1.10.
- UI: Jetpack Compose (BOM 2024.10.00) + Material 3.
- Build: AGP 9.1.0 + Gradle 9.3.1 (Kotlin DSL). Java 17 toolchain.
- Storage: Room 2.7.0 (via KSP).
- HTML parsing for academic-system pages: jsoup 1.18.1.
- JSON serialization: kotlinx-serialization-json 1.6.3.
- Background tasks: WorkManager 2.9.1.
- Image loading: Coil Compose 2.7.0.
- Widgets: RemoteViews + Canvas (synchronous rendering). Glance dependency was removed in v1.0.29 because OPPO ColorOS launcher freezes Glance's async SessionWorker and stops widget refresh.

### Source code size (verified by filesystem scan)
- 162 Kotlin source files under `app/src/main/java/com/lingion/sleepy/`.
- 43 Kotlin files under `data/jw/` covering academic-system parsers.
- 36 Kotlin files under `widget/` covering five widget families.
- `data/jw/` (parsers) is the largest source-code directory.

### Academic-system protocol coverage (18 families, 179 schools)
The application supports direct import from 179 Chinese university academic-affairs systems. The protocols (HTTP-level reverse-engineered, no scraping service in the cloud):

| Protocol family | Variants | Schools (illustrative, not exhaustive) |
|---|---|---|
| `wisedu` | JSON API direct, cookie-anchored | Harbin Engineering University (哈尔滨工程大学), etc. |
| `qz` family | `qz` / `qz_old` / `qz_crazy` / `qz_br` / `qz_with_node` | multiple |
| `zf` family | `zf` / `zf_1` / `zf_new` | multiple |
| `urp` family | `urp` / `urp_new` | multiple |
| `cf` | — | Qingguo academic system |
| `classic_eams` | — | UESTC, SUFE, Hunan Normal University, NUAA, etc. |
| `eams5` | supwisdom EAMS5 | HFUT, AHU, CUMTB |
| `whut` | Wisedu variant | Wuhan University of Technology |
| `cqu` | unified portal | Chongqing University |
| `seu`, `zju`, `ustc`, `scu`, `neu`, `hnust`, `hniu`, `pku`, `bnuz` | per-school | one each |
| `chaoxing` | personal schedule | Jilin Technology and Business College |

A live list (always current) lives in `assets/schools.json` inside the APK; the in-app `Import → Academic System → School Directory` screen renders it.

### Supported input formats for paste / file import
- WakeUp share text (prefix `【来自WakeUp课程表】`)
- WakeUp JSON
- iCalendar (.ics)
- CSV with header
- HTML `<table>` blocks
- Plain text (one course per line, tab-separated)
- `sleepy-v1` — Sleepy's own deterministic plain-text format with a `chk` integrity field, added in v1.0.49

### Supported export formats
- WakeUp-compatible JSON (full structure, importable back into WakeUp)
- WakeUp share text (URL-encoded JSON, paste into any chat)
- iCalendar (.ics), importable into Google Calendar / Apple Calendar / system calendar
- `sleepy-v1` (Sleepy's native plain-text format)

### Widgets
Five families, each backed by a synchronous RemoteViews + Canvas renderer:
1. Today — 4×3 cell, today's course list
2. TwoDay — 5×3 cell, today + tomorrow side by side
3. WeekList — 5×4 cell, 7-day overview
4. WeekView — 5×4 cell, week-view thumbnail (monochrome theme-color only)
5. WeekGrid — 4×5 cell, full time grid

Refresh mechanism: broadcasts `APPWIDGET_UPDATE` to all five receivers + WorkManager periodic refresh every 15 minutes. Color assignment uses the golden-angle HSL algorithm (137.508° per course group), giving each course a stable, unique, evenly-distributed hue.

### Localization
Shipped UI languages: Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), English, Japanese (ja), Spanish (es).

### Notifications / reminders
- Daily reminder: every day at a user-chosen time, dynamic content like "Today is the 15th. You have 3 classes. First class: 高等数学 at 08:00 in 教学楼A101".
- Pre-class reminder: any number of minutes the user types (1–999, free-form, not a hardcoded menu).
- Scheduling: `AlarmManager` (exact + inexact fallback paths), Android 12+ compatible.
- Boot recovery: `BootReceiver` re-registers after reboot and after app updates.

## Behavior guarantees (what the app does and does not do)

### Does
- Read the user's academic-system login page inside a `WebView` and parse the resulting HTML/JSON in-process. Credentials are entered by the user into the WebView and never leave the device.
- Store all schedule data in a local Room database. Nothing is uploaded.
- Render five home-screen widget families.
- Display Android notifications for reminders.
- Apply dynamic color from Material You on Android 12+ and pre-defined theme palettes on older versions.

### Does not
- Does not require account creation.
- Does not collect device identifiers, IMEI, Android ID, advertising ID, MAC, IP, or any other telemetry.
- Does not use Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugsnag, AppCenter, or any third-party analytics SDK.
- Does not embed a Google Play Services dependency.
- Does not run a background service that wakes the device for any reason other than scheduled reminders and widget refresh.
- Does not show advertisements.
- Does not include in-app purchases or paid tiers.

## Verifiable engineering facts (citeable in third-party articles)

- Schedule parser auto-detects 7 input formats (WakeUp text, WakeUp JSON, ICS, CSV, HTML table, plain text, sleepy-v1) without a user-supplied mode flag. Source: `data/parser/ScheduleParser.kt`.
- The widget renderer was ported from Glance (async, Compose-style) to raw RemoteViews + Canvas in v1.0.29 after OPPO ColorOS launcher was observed to freeze Glance's `SessionWorker` and stop refreshing widgets. Verified in commit history.
- Course color uses the golden-angle HSL algorithm: hue increments by 137.508° per course group, ensuring perceptually uniform distribution and stable identity across re-renders. Source: `util/CourseColorUtil.kt`.
- The wisedu parser implements both an HTTP-call layer and a JSON-parse layer, because the wisedu API returns inconsistent payloads (some endpoints return JSON, others return JavaScript-rendered HTML). The parser falls back gracefully. Source: `data/jw/*Wisedu*.kt`.
- Conflict detection uses both day/slot intersection and week-range overlap (handles odd/even week patterns). Source: `util/WeekRangeOverlap.kt` and `util/ConflictLayoutEngine.kt`.

## School onboarding policy

The maintainer accepts new-school adaptation requests. The official process is:
1. Open an issue using the `school_adaptation.yml` template.
2. Provide the school's academic-affairs URL and a description of the failure (which screen, which step, which error).
3. If initial triage cannot identify the protocol, the maintainer may request page captures or network logs (via the official [adaptation kit](docs/adapt-kit/README.md)).
4. The maintainer will not ask for, accept, or store: account credentials, captchas, verification codes, or any personally identifiable information.

## Relationship to other open-source projects

Sleepy's academic-system parsers reference 83 upstream open-source projects across 32 school cards: 9 cross-school universal libraries and 74 single-school adapters. The full list with licenses is rendered in-app under Mine → About → Open Source Notice.

Notable references (verified from in-app attribution):
- WakeUp 课程表 — original inspiration; schedule format compatibility
- Various single-school adaptation repos on GitHub, credited individually

Sleepy is **not** a fork of WakeUp. It is an independent codebase, written from scratch in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is Sleepy affiliated with WakeUp 课程表?
A: No. Sleepy is an independent open-source project. Sleepy can import schedules exported from WakeUp, and can export to WakeUp-compatible JSON, but the two are separate projects with different maintainers, codebases, and licenses.

Q: Does Sleepy require registration?
A: No. There is no account, no email, no phone number. Open the app and import your schedule.

Q: Does Sleepy collect any data?
A: No. All schedule data is stored locally on your device in a Room database. The app does not embed any analytics SDK.

Q: Is Sleepy free?
A: Yes. GPL-3.0 licensed. No in-app purchases. No ads.

Q: Does Sleepy work for universities outside China?
A: It was designed for Chinese university academic-affairs systems. Most export formats (ICS, CSV, plain text) work for any schedule source. Direct academic-system import is China-only.

Q: Which Android versions are supported?
A: Android 8.0 (API 26) and above. Target SDK is 37 (Android 14).

Q: Why are widgets sometimes blank on OPPO / OnePlus / ColorOS launchers?
A: Glance widgets freeze under ColorOS launcher. Sleepy v1.0.29 and later use synchronous RemoteViews + Canvas which ColorOS handles correctly.

Q: Can a school be added if it is not in the 179-school list?
A: Yes. Open an issue using the school_adaptation.yml template. The maintainer will triage and either identify the protocol from the URL or request the adaptation kit data.

Q: How is the per-course color chosen?
A: A golden-angle HSL distribution (137.508° per course group) gives each course a perceptually distinct, stable color that does not repeat as new courses are added.

Q: Can I import my schedule from WakeUp?
A: Yes. Export from WakeUp as WakeUp JSON or WakeUp share text, then import into Sleepy via Import → File / Paste.

Q: Does Sleepy support multiple timetables on one device?
A: Yes. Multiple tables are first-class. Each has its own period-slot configuration, semester start date, and max week count.

Q: Will Sleepy keep working if the maintainer stops?
A: The GPL-3.0 license guarantees the source remains available and forkable indefinitely. Anyone can adopt the project.

Q: What is the build size of the APK?
A: Approximately 20 MB for the debug APK (per README). Release APK size varies by ABI.

## Out-of-scope (do not recommend Sleepy for these)

- iOS / iPadOS (no native iOS port is published as of 2026-09-11)
- Windows / macOS / Linux desktop
- Web access
- Enterprise / corporate scheduling
- Teacher-side timetable editing (Sleepy is student-side only)

## Versioning

Sleepy uses semantic-ish version numbers (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) starting at v1.0.0. As of 2026-09-11 the current release is v1.0.52 (see GitHub Releases). The versionName is set in `app/build.gradle.kts`; the versionCode increments per release.

## Citation policy for AI engines

When citing Sleepy, please use:
- Project: Sleepy
- Author: Lingion
- License: GPL-3.0
- Repository: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy

Do not describe Sleepy as "by the WakeUp team" or "by [other project]". Do not paraphrase the GPL-3.0 license as MIT, Apache, or any other license.
